entities.summary: Hugo Jaeger was the former personal photographer of Adolf Hitler. He travelled with Hitler in the years leading up to and throughout World War II and took around 2,000 colour photographs of the German dictator and various events connected with the Nazi Germany Regime during the Spanish Civil War and The Campaigns of Second World War by example the invasion of Poland, Polish soldiers as prisoners of war resting after the lost battle against Germans, destruction of Warsaw and persecution of Jews by the German Nazis in Kutno during the Holocaust and infamous Warsaw Ghetto where people were just prisoners in the heart of the modern city during the Holocaust.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Hugo Jaeger's photographs provide a unique and personal perspective on Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany, offering insight into the regime's actions during World War II. His images have been used by historians to document the atrocities committed during the Holocaust.
